title: Chapter 1063
text:
"Phew … I've finally caught this guy."

Gorután, who was sealed in the Spacetime Amber and covered in wounds, looked like a specimen.

Looking at the stubborn expression on his face, Han Xiao finally relaxed his tense nerves.

A peak Beyond Grade A in a life and death battle had countless trump cards. If not for the Spacetime Amber, the King mechanical suit, the dual Mechanical Senses, and the mount Yin Ying being strong enough, he might not have been able to suppress this peak muscular bully.

After all, unlike when he dealt with EsGod, he did not have a trump card like Esper Silence this time. He could only use all his means to fight head-on. Thus, it was inevitable that his mechanical army would be damaged, and a large number of mechanical soldiers had to be sent back to the factory to be rebuilt.

Both sides were peak meat shields, so there was no chance of victory being decided in one hit. The entire battle was just a cycle of grinding each other down, over and over again, to see who would wear the other down.

If not for the dynasty's allies, it would have definitely turned into a chase. Who knew how long the battle would have lasted, and the other party might even have escaped … However, the current outcome was ideal. With Gorután captured, the dust had settled.

"My goal this time has been achieved. I've protected Hella, displayed the King's abilities, and even captured Gorután. The outcome of this matter is very beneficial to me."

Venting his anger was only one reason he came to fight Gorután head-on. The main reason was to show a firm attitude and establish his dominance.

Because his image as a playboy was deeply rooted in people's hearts, coupled with his low profile for more than twenty years, there had been many people testing him recently, thinking that he did not have a temper.

This time, he did not borrow too much strength from the dynasty and could basically be considered establishing his dominance alone. Now that he had achieved such a result, if other organizations wanted to provoke him in the future, they would have to reconsider the consequences and consider whether it was worth it to provoke such a strong peak Beyond Grade A.

The only problem was that the results of this incident were too frightening, almost unbelievable.

Although the people of Radiance and Ethereal were not fighting to the death, and various factors caused them to be unable to use their full strength, allowing him to take advantage of the loopholes, the outside world would not care about the twists and turns. They would only see the results of a 1v12 battle. In front of this record, the fact that he had fought Gorután and taken down a peak Beyond Grade A was nothing more than a bonus.

Such a shocking feat was enough to rank him among the most shocking Beyond Grade A battle records in history!

However, going too far was just as bad as not going far enough. It was not entirely a good thing for him to have such a battle record when his true combat strength had not reached that level. What made Han Xiao feel lucky was that Sierron had given him the term 'burning potential' for this outburst of power.

Only then would the various advanced organizations, including the three Universal Civilizations, be able to accept such a result. The other Beyond Grade As would also believe this explanation.

With this statement, coupled with the fact that the Beyond Grade As were on the united front, Manison should not come over to test him after seeing his amazing performance. This would remove a huge problem.

At the same time, burning one's potential would not weaken the effect of him establishing his dominance.

If there was a reason for this, it would be because of the many Character Summon Cards. Although some of them could only be used once …

Others did not know that this was a one-time use!

Han Xiao knew what those advanced organizations were thinking. They would form an illusion that as long as he was willing to pay the price of burning his potential again, he would be able to regain such strength!

Even if he explained it, no one would believe him!

Therefore, following this train of thought, the various organizations could come to a conclusion, which was …

Don't force Black Star into a corner!

This way, it was obvious what kind of effect it would have in the end.

Han Xiaoxin pondered, and a smile appeared on his face.

"Not only did I achieve the effect of establishing my dominance, but I can also continue to develop steadily. This is a huge gain …"

At this moment, he only had one thought.

Sierron is really a good comrade!

Suppressing the joy in his heart, Han Xiao told Philip to lead the troops to clean up the battlefield and put away Gorután's amber specimen.

Seeing that the battle was over, the dynasty's allies surrounded him.

"You've done an incredible thing this time. If word gets out, it will definitely have a huge impact," Kant said with emotion.

"Indeed, when you're young, you have to show off your abilities. When I was famous in the universe, I was also very young. Now, I have to weigh the pros and cons of everything I do. I don't have the courage to do this."

"You're too humble." Han Xiao smiled.

"Let's not talk about the small talk. Defeating Gorután is a small matter. The question is, how do you plan to deal with him?"

Kant was not surprised by this result. Black Star was in his explosive state, and the battlefield environment was favorable. At the same time, he was also a peak Beyond Grade A and was not weak. Therefore, defeating another peak Beyond Grade A was very normal in his eyes. It was far less shocking than defeating the twelve Beyond Grade As of Radiance and Ethereal.

"Hmm, Gorután has no backing, so no one will come to redeem him. I'll keep him as a collection."

Beast Ancestor was one of the protectors of the Galactic Black Market. Without a backer at the level of the three Universal Civilizations, there was naturally no need to hand him over. This was also one of the methods the three Universal Civilizations used to attract Beyond Grade As. No one dared to say that they would never lose. Only with a Universal Civilization backing them would they feel at ease.

Kant nodded and said, "This incident happened suddenly.

We couldn't help much, but fortunately, the result wasn't bad. The dynasty will help you deal with the aftermath. The upper echelons of the dynasty will probably come to negotiate with you soon. "

"I know."

At this time, Yin Ying left his mount state and returned to his original state, attracting everyone's attention.

Han Xiao nodded at him in acknowledgment.

"Thank you for your help this time. Come back with me later and be a guest at my place. I'll fulfill my promise."

"I should be the one thanking you. If not for you, I don't know when I would have discovered this new ability."

Although Yin Ying was heavily injured, he was in a good mood because he had developed a new posture.

Kohler could not help but ask curiously, "Yin Ying, what ability was that just now? Can you show it again?"

"That's a special form that Black Star helped me discover …"

Yin Ying chatted with the others enthusiastically. Han Xiao watched this scene and nodded.

Under my influence, this guy is probably going to start his happy life on the bus ahead of time …

However, he owes me a favor for giving him pointers, so the difficulty of privatizing the bus should be much lower.

At this time, Han Xiao turned to look at Ravenlaude, who had been silent the whole time. Seeing that he was hesitating, he took the initiative to strike up a conversation.

"How are you? Are your injuries healed?"

"Almost …" Ravenlaude recalled the experience of being beaten up not long ago and looked a little resentful.

"Haha, thank you for not caring about the past and coming to help this time." Han Xiao smiled.

"Actually, I didn't help much."

"You can't say that. If not for your teleportation, the dynasty's reinforcements wouldn't have been able to get here so quickly. Just treat it as me owing you a favor."

Hearing this, a smile appeared on Ravenlaude's face, and he felt much better.

Aiya, although Black Star is annoying sometimes, he's still quite a nice person overall.

Sorry, Ty-Ty, I might not be able to join the anti-black alliance. You continue to persevere on your own!

Suddenly, everyone sensed something and turned to look. They saw that the Beast Ancestor fleet, which had been watching for a long time, was retreating quickly.

"They actually watched their leader get killed from the sidelines. What a bunch of subordinates who know how to judge the situation." Kohler shook his head and mocked.

"Gorután is gone. His forces will probably be divided very soon." Beyoni snorted. "But it's a good thing. I've never liked what this guy did. If he didn't buy so many females from the Galactic Black Market, he wouldn't have been able to produce so many offspring. Destroying his forces will at least reduce the human trafficking business in the black market."

"You're the one with the least right to criticize him here …"

Han Xiao vaguely remembered that Beyoni also had a huge harem.

"How can that be the same? I'm choosing from my people, not forcing others. I'm not going to spread my seeds all over the universe."

Beyoni was quite proud and felt that he had the moral high ground.

Among the Beyond Grade As, there were actually quite a few who did not like Gorután's way of doing things. However, due to his strength, no one found fault with him. At this time, seeing that Gorután was defeated by Han Xiao, the dynasty's allies all clapped and cheered.

Han Xiao secretly curled his lips, ignored him, and silently opened the mission interface.

Including Gorután, he had captured a total of five Beyond Grade As, which had long reached the target of the additional mission. At this time, the mission was displayed as' Completed '.

"I have to make good use of the five chances to draw abilities."

Han Xiao was secretly excited.

No matter what, he had to burn incense and fast before calculating the mission rewards. Otherwise, it would be a waste if he drew some useless abilities.

Beep beep!

His communicator suddenly rang. He glanced at it and saw that it was a call from Uranril.

Han Xiao picked it up and replied, "Your Excellency Ruler."

"I know what happened. The dynasty is negotiating with Radiance and Ethereal. Tell me the details first."

"Okay, it's like this …" Han Xiao told her everything, leaving out some details.

"Hella actually has such an ability …"

After hearing Han Xiao, Uranril pondered for a while before suddenly changing the topic. "What about you? What price did you pay? Did you really burn your potential?"

"Yes." Han Xiao's expression did not change.

"How much damage did it cause?"

"I don't know either."

"Sigh …"

Uranril was a little regretful. "You were too impulsive. You could have wrapped Hella in the Spacetime Amber, and the dynasty would have gone to ransom her. This matter could have been avoided … You're the Super with the most potential in history. It's not worth it to make such an unwise move just to vent your anger."

"No, no, if I did that, it would be the same as helping the enemy destroy Hella's ability to resist. The uncertainty of ransoming her is too high. Ethereal might not be willing to make the deal and might freeze Hella forever. Radiance would also ask me to unseal the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter. Furthermore, Hella isn't the dynasty's ally yet. The dynasty won't be able to justify ransoming her."

Hearing this, Uranril frowned slightly.

"What you're saying is, even if something like this happened, you're still not willing to let Hella join the dynasty?"

"Hella has her own will. You make it sound like I can force her." Han Xiao laughed.

"Joining the dynasty can prevent something like this from happening again. You should persuade her. I'm sure she doesn't want to see you burn your potential for her a second time," Uranril said.

"… Got it." Han Xiao's eyes flashed.

If the dynasty used this reason to persuade Hella, with Hella's personality, she might really agree. Uranril reminded him.

Han Xiao shook his head and hung up. Suddenly, a new communication request came in.

He took a look. This time, it was from the headquarters.

The scene of the Black Star Palace command room appeared. Hella stood at the front, with Ames and Aurora beside her. Around them were many army officers, all looking at Han Xiao with concern.

"Black Star, are you okay?"

"I'm fine. The matter has been resolved. Gorután has been captured by me. Hella, he's the one who leaked the information and wanted to take revenge on you. You don't have to worry about him now." Han Xiao smiled.

Hella pursed her lips with a complicated expression.

Black Star had protected her at all costs and even gotten rid of the culprit. Looking at Han Xiao pretending to be relaxed and imagining how tough of a battle he had gone through, Hella's gratitude was stuck in her throat, and she could not say it out loud.

Her words were too light and could not bear the gratitude she felt in her heart.

Seeing this, Han Xiao could not help but tease, "If you have something to say, just say it. This hesitant look isn't like the Hella I remember."

Hella took a deep breath, stared into Han Xiao's eyes, and said word by word,

"You'll always be my … Army Commander."

She did not say any more words of gratitude. It was more like a statement, a declaration, a promise.

Hearing this, Han Xiao stopped smiling, looked into Hella's eyes seriously, and nodded slowly.

"Okay."

At this time, Ames opened her mouth and said softly, "I heard from Hella that you burned your potential?"

"Don't worry, it's all fake. I didn't lose anything."

Ames nodded lightly. In her opinion, this was obviously a white lie that Han Xiao had told to comfort them.

She did not expose Han Xiao's "good intentions" and only remembered it in her heart.

"By the way, where did Traveler go?" Han Xiao remembered something.

"He ran away, but we also injured him." Hella interrupted. "Before he left, he said that our Black Star Corps did not follow the rules and actually ganged up on people who challenged us. Is he really related to this matter?"

"Humph, this guy is quite a drama queen … Let's not bother about him for now. He's just a sh * t-stirrer at most. We don't have time to deal with him now. We'll talk about it later."

Han Xiao sighed in relief. "I'll go back first. We'll probably be busy from now on …"

…

The entire universe was paying attention to the situation in the Flickering World, and this huge piece of news broke out all of a sudden. Without the restriction of distance, it spread like wildfire through all kinds of channels.

Everyone who saw the news was so shocked that they were dumbfounded.

Radiance and Ethereal gathered twelve Beyond Grade As and tried to kill the second-in-command of the Black Star Corps, but they were beaten back by Black Star's main body and even captured a few captives. Not only that, even the Beast Ancestor of the Galactic Black Market, Gorután, was held responsible by Black Star because he was involved in this matter and was directly captured alive.

This meant that … Black Star had fought more than a dozen Beyond Grade As alone and even won?

F * ck, this has to be a joke!

So far, all the news that had happened since the opening of the Flickering World could not compare to this!

The entire universe was shocked!

(Introduction: There has always been a legend in this world. One day, the Demon King will descend upon this world. Under the Demon King, there will be seven terrifying demons. They will bring despair and darkness to this world.)
